mapper.select: SELECT m.name, m.nationality, s.expected_return_date, g.target_currency, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM savings_roadmap r WHERE r.member_id = m.member_id) AS roadmap_exists, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_rate_condition_response c WHERE c.member_id = m.member_id) AS rate_conditions_answered, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM monthly_saving_plan p JOIN savings_roadmap r ON r.savings_roadmap_id = p.savings_roadmap_id WHERE r.member_id = m.member_id AND p.plan_month = DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE((SELECT dc.today FROM demo_clock dc WHERE dc.member_id = m.member_id), CURDATE()), '%Y-%m-01')) AS monthly_saving_confirmed FROM member m LEFT JOIN stay_info s ON s.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN goal g ON g.member_id = m.member_id WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId}
